name: Thunderbirds at 60
overview: Thunderbirds - FAB at 60 is the definitive 60th-anniversary retrospective of Gerry and Sylvia Anderson's groundbreaking television series. Featuring rare archive footage and interviews with an incredible line-up of contributors - including Jonathan Ross, J. Michael Straczynski, John Logan, Jon Culshaw, Sophie Aldred, Nicola Bryant, Sanjeev Bhaskar, Richard Taylor, Dee Anderson, Jamie Anderson, Joe Kraemer, and many more - the documentary explores the inception of Thunderbirds, the creation of its unforgettable characters, and the revolutionary production techniques that transformed television storytelling. Guests share their personal memories of growing up with the series and reflect on its influence across film, TV, and pop culture. From Barry Gray's iconic score to its lasting creative impact, this is a heartfelt celebration of a show that continues to inspire generations and remains truly... FAB
